verdict.score_rationale: The board is readable with effort at the 6–6.5 anchor: its regions and primary stages are clear, but several long feedback and handoff routes require close tracing.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and label chips have generous clearance, though the lower AI-to-human handoff corridor packs multiple long lines and labels into the same horizontal band.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: The numbered intake, AI self-service, human support, and quality-review regions are visually distinct and make participant ownership immediately apparent.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Arrowheads, labels, colors, and dashed styles are generally visible, but the blue review feedback loop and gray unresolved/person-requested routes make large detours and force careful endpoint tracing.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: The intake branches, AI decision, resolution path, escalation, and callback outcome are discernible, but the widely distributed cross-region loops obscure the main end-to-end flow on first viewing.
